thought.text: All backend services are healthy. Let me check the frontend config placeholder replacement and Temporal.

reasoning_content:
All backend services respond 200 on /healthz (port 18014 is llm-client, no readiness probe, 404 expected).

Now let me verify Temporal namespaces/workflows, and check the API docs / openapi for key services. Also check whether the frontend can access backend APIs through oauth2-proxy.

Let me also validate a portion of the actual workflow path is achievable. The guide's "Run a Workflow" needs an LLM and Docling, which are external placeholders. We can still check that the formal-completeness backend is functional and API endpoints respond.

Let me check the Temporal UI and namespace. Also let me verify the Temporal worker connectivity.

Let me also verify one API endpoint with the token to confirm end-to-end auth. E.g., the project-logic service. But which service is project-logic? Let me check process-compose for port mapping.

Actually, let me just test the frontend proxy path for an API through oauth2-proxy. But that needs cookies. Simpler: test direct backend with Keycloak token.

Let me check the config of the frontend about API base URL. The __APP_CONFIG__ has placeholders that get replaced at runtime — check vite config for replacement. Let's look at whether VITE_API_BASE_URL was replaced. In the dev server the HTML has __VITE_API_BASE_URL__ placeholder. That's suspicious — maybe it's replaced by a plugin at runtime, or maybe it should be set. Let's check.

Actually in dev, Vite typically replaces those in a middleware. Let me look at vite.config.
